name: cumcm-modeling
title_zh: 数学建模赛题从读题到灵敏度分析的全流程副驾
tagline_zh: 赛题数据乱、模型选型难、代码跑不通？它陪你走完从问题拆解到数值求解、验证和鲁棒性分析。
tagline_en: Messy data, tough model choice, code that won't run? It walks you through problem framing, model selection.
desc_en: Use when a mathematical modeling competition task needs data analysis, mathematical formulation, model selection, algorithm design, numerical solution, Python implementation, validation, sensitivity, or robustness analysis.
why_zh: 不是给答案，而是把建模竞赛的完整方法论固化成流程：先帮你把赛题翻译成数学语言，再按数据特征推荐模型族。
why_en: Not an answer machine—it hardcodes the contest methodology: translates the prompt into math, suggests model families by data.
limit_zh: 只覆盖数学建模竞赛场景，不处理纯工程仿真或商业数据分析；需要你提供赛题文本和可用的 Python 环境。
limit_en: Only for math modeling contest tasks; not for pure engineering simulation or general business analytics. Needs your problem text and a working.
title_en: Full-process copilot for math modeling contests, from.
